documents.reviewer_notes: Verification in progress. The previously recorded Parliament-hosted PDF returned a 404 error during an access attempt; retry the URL and locate an alternative official copy. PacLII provides a consolidated Constitution marked as at 16 May 2025, but this date does not establish currency as at October 2026. Official Parliament records identify Constitutional Amendment No. 49 (Declaration of Papua New Guinea as a Christian Country) Law 2025. Parliament records also identify the Constitutional Amendment (Motion of No Confidence) Law 2024, subsequently reported as Constitutional Amendment No. 48. Obtain the enacted and certified texts, establish commencement and current legal effect, and locate the authoritative Supreme Court judgment concerning Amendment No. 48. Confirm redistribution permissions before approval.
